page_title: NME Drug and New Biologic Approvals in 2004
row_count_note: Page prints two tables: 31 NDA approvals and 5 BLA approvals (36 total novel rows).

rows.indication: Spiriva HandiHaler is indicated for the long-term, once-daily, maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and emphysema.
Alimta is indicated in the treatment of patients with malignant pleural mesothelioma whose disease is either unresectable or who are otherwise not candidates for curative surgery.

Sensipar is indicated for the treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism in patients with chronic kidney disease on dialysis, and the treatment of hypercalcemia in patients with parathyroid carcinoma.

Ketek is indicated for the treatment of infections caused by susceptible strains of the designated microorganisms in the conditions listed below, for patients 18 years old and above. (1) Acute bacterial exacerbation of chronic bronchitis due to Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, or Moraxella catarrhalis. (2) Acute bacterial sinusitis due to Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, Moraxella catarrhalis or Staphylococcus aureus. (3) Community-acquired pneumonia (of mild to moderate severity) due to Streptococcus pneumoniae (including multi-drug resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae [MDRSP] strains), Haemophilus influenzae, Moraxella catarrhalis, Chlamydophila pneumoniae, or Mycoplasma pneumoniae.

ChiRhoStim is indicated for (1) Stimulation of pancreatic secretions, including bicarbonate, to aid in the diagnosis of pancreatic exocrine dysfunction, (2) Stimulation of gastrin secretion to aid in the diagnosis of gastrinoma, and (3) Stimulation of pancreatic secretions to facilitate the identification of the ampulla of Vater and accessory papilla during endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP).
Apidra is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with diabetes mellitus for the control of hyperglycemia.

Apokyn is indicated for the acute, intermittent treatment of hypomobility, "off" episodes ("end-of-dose wearing off" and unpredictable "on/off" episodes) associated with advanced Parkinson's disease. [Bertek = Mylan Bertek Pharmaceuticals; Mylan is the parent.]

Vitrase is indicated as an adjuvant to increase the absorption and dispersion of other injected drugs; for hypodermoclysis; and as an adjunct in subcutaneous urography for improving resorption of radiopaque agents.
Tindamax is indicated for the treatment of trichomoniasis.

Vidaza is indicated for the treatment of patients with the following myelodysplastic syndrome subtypes: refractory anemia or refractory anemia with ringed sideroblasts (if accompanied by neutropenia or thrombocytopenia and requiring transfusions), refractory anemia with excess blasts, refractory anemia with excess blasts in transformation, and chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

Xifaxan is indicated for the treatment of patients (> 12 years of age) with travelers' diarrhea caused by noninvasive strains of Escherichia coli. Xifaxan should not be used in patients with diarrhea complicated by fever or blood in the stool or diarrhea due to pathogens other than Escherichia coli.
Sanctura is indicated for the treatment of overactive bladder associated with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency, and urinary frequency.

NutreStore is indicated for the treatment of short bowel syndrome in patients receiving specialized nutritional support when used in conjunction with a recombinant human growth that is approved for this indication.
Campral is indicated for the maintenance of abstinence from alcohol in patients with alcohol dependence who are abstinent at treatment initiation.
Cymbalta is indicated for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD).
Pentetate Calcium Trisodium is indicated for the treatment of internal contamination with plutonium, americium or curium to increase the rates of elimination.
Pentetate Zinc Trisodium is indicated for the treatment of internal contamination with plutonium, americium or curium to increase the rates of elimination.
Fosrenol is indicated to reduce serum phosphate in patients with end stage renal disease.

Amphadase is indicated as an adjuvant to increase the absorption and dispersion of other injected drugs; for hypodermoclysis; and as as adjunct in subcutaneous urography for improving resorption of radiopaque agents.
Omacor is indicated as an adjunct to diet to reduce triglyceride (TG) levels in adult patients with TG levels > 500 mg/dL.
Tarceva is indicated for the treatment of locally advanced or metastatic Non Small-Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) after failure of at least one prior chemotherapy regimen.
VESIcare is indicated for the treatment of overactive bladder with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency, and urinary frequency.

Multihance is indicated for intravenous use in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the CNS in adults to visualize lesions with abnormal blood brain barrier or abnormal vascularity of the brain, spine, and associated tissues.
Lunesta is indicated for the treatment of insomnia. [FDA table prints established name 'Eszopicline'; standard spelling is eszopiclone. Verbatim.]
Visionblue is indicated as an aid in ophthalmic surgery by staining the anterior capsule of the lens.
Macugen is indicated for the treatment of neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration.
Enablex is indicated for the treatment of overactive bladder.

Prialt is indicated for the management of severe chronic pain in patients for whom intrathecal (IT) therapy is warranted and who are intolerant of or refractory to other treatment, such as systemic analgesics, adjunctive therapies, or IT morphine.
Clolar is indicated for the treatment of pediatric patients 1 to 21 years old with relapsed or refractory acute lymphoblastic leukemia after at least two prior regimens.
Ventavis is indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension.
Lyrica is indicated for the management of neuropathic pain associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy.

Erbitux is indicated for the treatment of EGFR-expressing, metastatic colorectal carcinoma in patients who are refractory to irinotecan-based chemotherapy (in combination with irinotecan); Treatment of EGFR-expressing, metastatic colorectal carcinoma in patients who are intolerant to irinotecan-based chemotherapy (administered as a single agent). [US commercialization partner Bristol-Myers Squibb.]
Avastin is indicated for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic carcinoma of the colon and rectum (in combination with intravenous 5-fluorouracil-based chemotherapy).

NeutroSpec is indicated for scintigraphic imaging of patients with equivocal signs and symptoms of appendicitis who are five years of age or older. [Marketing later voluntarily suspended (2005) after reported serious adverse events; flagged irregularity.]

Tysabri is indicated in the treatment of patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS) to reduce the frequency of clinical exacerbations. [Voluntarily withdrawn from market Feb 2005 after PML case; returned to market 2006 with restricted distribution. Flagged irregularity.]

Kepivance is indicated to decrease the incidence and duration of severe oral mucositis in patients with hematologic malignancies receiving myelotoxic therapy requiring hematopoietic stem cell support.
